repos.name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
repos.eli5: It’s like a super‑smart librarian that reads the newest posts on Reddit, X, YouTube, and other sites, then writes a short, easy‑to‑understand summary for you. Programmers and anyone who wants quick, up‑to‑date info use it.

repos.name: alibaba/open-code-review
repos.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repos.eli5: Imagine a robot proofreader that looks at the changes you made to code, spots mistakes like typos or security holes, and writes helpful comments right on the line. Developers use it to catch bugs before they ship.

repos.name: Tencent/LoopForge
repos.description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
repos.eli5: It’s like a kitchen where you give a robot chef a recipe (a workflow), and it cooks up code, checks it, and serves a finished pull request, with humans stepping in when needed. Teams building software use it to automate and control code‑writing bots.

repos.name: dream-num/univer
repos.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
repos.eli5: Think of it as a set of LEGO blocks that let you build your own digital office with spreadsheets, docs, and calculators that both people and AI helpers can use together. App makers add it to their products to give users a familiar office feel.

repos.name: getarcaneapp/arcane
repos.description: Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone
repos.eli5: It’s a friendly remote control for Docker containers, letting anyone start, stop, and manage their apps without needing to learn complex commands. Developers and system admins use it to handle Docker more easily.

repos.name: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
repos.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
repos.eli5: These are like plug‑in toys that give a coding robot new tricks, such as designing or building things, so it can work with Google’s Stitch platform. Developers add them to make their AI assistants more capable.

repos.name: cursor/plugins
repos.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
repos.eli5: It’s a toolbox of ready‑made add‑ons that give the Cursor code editor extra powers, like teaching helpers or automating tasks, so programmers can pick the ones they need. Developers using Cursor install them to boost productivity.

repos.name: obra/superpowers
repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.eli5: Think of it as a playbook that tells coding robots how to work together step‑by‑step, like a sports coach guiding a team. Software teams use it to make their AI assistants follow a reliable development process.

repos.name: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
repos.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
repos.eli5: It’s a universal language that lets AI helpers talk to any app, like a translator that lets a robot and a human‑facing program understand each other. App builders use it to plug AI agents into their front‑ends easily.

repos.name: backnotprop/plannotator
repos.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
repos.eli5: Imagine a digital whiteboard where you can write notes, review code, and send feedback to AI helpers with one click, keeping everyone in the loop. Developers and teams use it to manage and review AI‑generated work.
